Подготовка на базата данни

Първата стъпка преди да притеглим базата данни е да я изтеглим от текущата директория с библиотеката haven.

library(haven)
library(survey)
## Loading required package: grid
## Loading required package: Matrix
## Loading required package: survival
## 
## Attaching package: 'survey'
## The following object is masked from 'package:graphics':
## 
##     dotchart
CMS_DATA_BG <- read_sav("CMS_logical_corrections_V1.sav")
head(CMS_DATA_BG)
library(dplyr)
## 
## Attaching package: 'dplyr'
## The following objects are masked from 'package:stats':
## 
##     filter, lag
## The following objects are masked from 'package:base':
## 
##     intersect, setdiff, setequal, union
CMS_DATA_BG <- CMS_DATA_BG %>%
  mutate(
    # keep existing Changed_dummy entries; treat NA as 0 only for this update step
    Changed_dummy = if_else(is.na(Changed_dummy), 0, Changed_dummy),

    missing_key = if_else(
      is.na(D2) | D2 >= 99 |                  # Age
      is.na(D1) | !(D1 %in% c(1, 2)) |        # Sex
      is.na(D26) | !(D26 %in% c(1, 2, 3, 4)), # Settlement
      1, 0
    ),

    # preserve prior 1s, add new 1s where key covariates are bad
    Changed_dummy = if_else(Changed_dummy == 1 | missing_key == 1, 1, 0)
  )

df_clean <- CMS_DATA_BG %>%
  mutate(
    age_group = case_when(
      D2 >= 18 & D2 <= 24 ~ "18-24",
      D2 <= 34 ~ "25-34",
      D2 <= 44 ~ "35-44",
      D2 <= 54 ~ "45-54",
      D2 <= 64 ~ "55-64",
      D2 >= 65 ~ "65+"
    ),
    sex = factor(D1, levels = c(1, 2), labels = c("Male", "Female")),
    urban = case_when(
      D26 %in% c(1, 2) ~ "City",
      D26 == 3 ~ "Town",
      D26 == 4 ~ "Rural"
    )
  )
# Share dropped
table(df_clean$Changed_dummy)
## 
##    0    1 
## 1004   10
# Distributions
table(df_clean$age_group)

## 18-24 25-34 35-44 45-54 55-64   65+ 
##    48   128   190   196   234   218
table(df_clean$sex)
## 
##   Male Female 
##    500    514
table(df_clean$urban)

Рейкинг и конструкция на пост-стратификационните тегла

library(eurostat)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
## 
## Attaching package: 'lubridate'
## The following objects are masked from 'package:base':
## 
##     date, intersect, setdiff, union
pop_raw <- get_eurostat("demo_pjan", time_format = "num")
## Dataset query already saved in cache_list.json...
## Reading cache file C:\Users\STOYCH~1.RUS\AppData\Local\Temp\Rtmp4M0RU4/eurostat/08b00d547fc0cb3969d9dc32d7f6bd9d.rds
## Table  demo_pjan  read from cache file:  C:\Users\STOYCH~1.RUS\AppData\Local\Temp\Rtmp4M0RU4/eurostat/08b00d547fc0cb3969d9dc32d7f6bd9d.rds
bg_pop <- pop_raw %>%
  filter(
    geo == "BG",
   TIME_PERIOD== 2025,              # survey year
    sex %in% c("M", "F"),
age %in% c(paste0("Y", 18:99), "Y_GE90")
  )
bg_pop_age_sex <- bg_pop %>%
  mutate(
    age_num = case_when(
      age == "Y_GE90" ~ 90,
      TRUE ~ as.numeric(sub("^Y", "", age))
    ),
    sex = recode(sex,
      "M" = "Male",
      "F" = "Female"
    ),
    age_group = case_when(
      age_num >= 18 & age_num <= 24 ~ "18-24",
      age_num >= 25 & age_num <= 34 ~ "25-34",
      age_num >= 35 & age_num <= 44 ~ "35-44",
      age_num >= 45 & age_num <= 54 ~ "45-54",
      age_num >= 55 & age_num <= 64 ~ "55-64",
      age_num >= 65               ~ "65+"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(age_group)) %>%
  group_by(age_group, sex) %>%
  summarise(pop = sum(values, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Freq = pop / sum(pop))

bg_pop_age_sex
pop_sex <- bg_pop_age_sex %>%
  group_by(sex) %>%
  summarise(pop = sum(pop), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Freq = pop / sum(pop))

pop_sex
sum(bg_pop_age_sex$Freq)
## [1] 1
urb_raw <- get_eurostat("ilc_lvho01", time_format = "num")
## Dataset query already saved in cache_list.json...
## Reading cache file C:\Users\STOYCH~1.RUS\AppData\Local\Temp\Rtmp4M0RU4/eurostat/ea0bc65593c7a9d7a9c68065031d34d4.rds
## Table  ilc_lvho01  read from cache file:  C:\Users\STOYCH~1.RUS\AppData\Local\Temp\Rtmp4M0RU4/eurostat/ea0bc65593c7a9d7a9c68065031d34d4.rds
#https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/databrowser/view/ILC_LVHO01__custom_1762022/default/table?lang=en

unique(urb_raw$deg_urb)
## [1] "DEG1"  "DEG2"  "DEG3"  "TOTAL"
bg_urban <- urb_raw %>%
  filter(
    geo == "BG",
    TIME_PERIOD == 2025,
    deg_urb %in% c("DEG1", "DEG2", "DEG3"), 
    incgrp=="TOTAL", 
    building=="TOTAL"
  )
pop_urban <- bg_urban %>%
  mutate(
    urban = case_when(
      deg_urb == "DEG1" ~ "City",
      deg_urb == "DEG2" ~ "Town",
      deg_urb == "DEG3" ~ "Rural"
    ),
    Freq = values / 100
  ) %>%
  select(urban, Freq)
sum(pop_urban$Freq)
## [1] 1
bg_pop_age_sex <- bg_pop_age_sex %>%
  mutate(
    age_group = factor(age_group,
      levels = c("18-24", "25-34", "35-44", "45-54", "55-64", "65+")),
    sex = factor(sex,
      levels = c("Male", "Female"))
  )

pop_urban <- pop_urban %>%
  mutate(
    urban = factor(urban,
      levels = c("City", "Town", "Rural"))
  )
design <- svydesign(
  ids = ~1,
  data = df_clean
)
## Warning in svydesign.default(ids = ~1, data = df_clean): No weights or
## probabilities supplied, assuming equal probability
raked <- rake(
  design,
  sample.margins = list(~age_group + sex, ~urban),
  population.margins = list(
    bg_pop_age_sex %>% select(age_group, sex, Freq),
    pop_urban %>% select(urban, Freq)
  )
)
df_clean$weight <- weights(raked, type = "analysis")
summary(df_clean$weight)
##      Min.   1st Qu.    Median      Mean   3rd Qu.      Max. 
## 0.0005404 0.0007716 0.0008479 0.0009862 0.0011252 0.0022930
df_clean$weight_ipw <- 1 / raked$prob
summary(df_clean$weight_ipw)
##      Min.   1st Qu.    Median      Mean   3rd Qu.      Max. 
## 0.0005404 0.0007716 0.0008479 0.0009862 0.0011252 0.0022930
df_clean$weight_final <- df_clean$weight / mean(df_clean$weight)
summary(df_clean$weight_final)
##    Min. 1st Qu.  Median    Mean 3rd Qu.    Max. 
##  0.5479  0.7824  0.8597  1.0000  1.1410  2.3251
# Urban
svytable(~urban, raked) / sum(svytable(~urban, raked))

## 0.418 0.308 0.274

svytable(~age_group + sex, raked) / sum(svytable(~age_group + sex, raked))

###Финална база данни в теглен дизайн

design_w <- svydesign(
  ids = ~1,
  data = df_clean,
  weights = ~weight_final
)

Сега ще тестваме някакви неща:

#Анализ

design_w <- update(
  design_w,

  # Administrative corruption perception
  admin_corr_index = rowMeans(cbind(A2, A3A, A3B, A3C), na.rm = TRUE),

  # Experienced administrative corruption
  experienced_corr_index = rowMeans(cbind(A12A, A12B, A13A, A13B, A13C), na.rm = TRUE),

  # Corruption tolerance / acceptability
  tolerance_index = rowMeans(cbind(A8, A9A, A9B, A9C, A9D, A10A, A10B, A10C, A10D), na.rm = TRUE)
)
design_w <- update(
  design_w,
  admin_corr_z = as.numeric(scale(admin_corr_index)),
  experienced_corr_z = as.numeric(scale(experienced_corr_index)),
  tolerance_z = as.numeric(scale(tolerance_index))
)
svymean(~admin_corr_index + experienced_corr_index + tolerance_index, design_w, na.rm = TRUE)
##                          mean     SE
## admin_corr_index       1.9652 0.0238
## experienced_corr_index 4.7328 0.0779
## tolerance_index        3.3319 0.0281
svyby(~admin_corr_index, ~D7, design_w, svymean, na.rm = TRUE)
svyby(~experienced_corr_index, ~D7, design_w, svymean, na.rm = TRUE)
svyby(~tolerance_index, ~D7, design_w, svymean, na.rm = TRUE)
m1 <- svyglm(
  admin_corr_z ~ factor(D7) + factor(D1) + age_group +
    factor(D3) + factor(D25B) + factor(D26),
  design = design_w
)

m2 <- svyglm(
  experienced_corr_z ~ factor(D7) + factor(D1) + age_group +
    factor(D3) + factor(D25B) + factor(D26),
  design = design_w
)

m3 <- svyglm(
  tolerance_z ~ factor(D7) + factor(D1) + age_group +
    factor(D3) + factor(D25B) + factor(D26),
  design = design_w
)

summary(m1)

library(dplyr)
library(broom)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(forcats)

# ---- 1. D7 label map ----
d7_labels <- c(
  "1"  = "Responsible state officials",
  "2"  = "Directors of companies and administrative institutions",
  "3"  = "Humanitarian, economic professionals and freelance occupations",
  "4"  = "Specialists with mathematical, technical and natural-science education",
  "5"  = "Middle ranking technicians",
  "6"  = "Administrative officials and middle ranking specialists",
  "7"  = "Office personnel",
  "8"  = "Trade and service employees",
  "9"  = "Low ranking managers",
  "10" = "Skilled workers",
  "11" = "Unskilled workers",
  "12" = "Unskilled workers in trade and services",
  "13" = "Hired workers in agriculture, forestry and fishing",
  "14" = "Farmers and fishermen",
  "15" = "Entrepreneurs and businessman",
  "16" = "Other employed",
  "17" = "Pensioners",
  "18" = "Students",
  "19" = "Disabled",
  "20" = "Housewives / maternity leave",
  "21" = "Unemployed",
  "22" = "Other not working"
)

# ---- 2. Helper function to extract and clean D7 coefficients ----
extract_d7 <- function(model, model_name) {
  broom::tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    filter(str_detect(term, "^factor\\(D7\\)")) %>%
    mutate(
      d7_code = str_remove(term, "^factor\\(D7\\)"),
      group = d7_labels[d7_code],
      group = ifelse(is.na(group), d7_code, group),
      group = str_wrap(group, width = 35),
      model = model_name
    ) %>%
    arrange(estimate) %>%
    mutate(group = factor(group, levels = group))
}

# ---- 3. Build separate datasets ----
plot_m1 <- extract_d7(m1, "Perceived administrative corruption")
plot_m2 <- extract_d7(m2, "Experienced administrative corruption")
plot_m3 <- extract_d7(m3, "Tolerance of corruption")

# ---- 4. Plot function ----
plot_d7_model <- function(df, title_text, subtitle_text = NULL) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = estimate, y = group)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5, color = "grey40") +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), height = 0.15, linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_point(size = 2.4) +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      subtitle = subtitle_text,
      x = "Difference in standard deviations relative to reference group",
      y = NULL,
      caption = "Points show regression coefficients for social groups (D7); lines show 95% confidence intervals.\nControls: sex, age group, education, income group, settlement type. Weighted survey estimates."
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 9)
    )
}

# ---- 5. Draw the three graphs ----
g1 <- plot_d7_model(
  plot_m1,
  "Perceived administrative corruption by social group",
  "Ordered from lowest to highest estimated score"
)

df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    D7_compact = case_when(
      D7 %in% c(1, 2, 6, 9) ~ "Public-sector / administrative elite",
      D7 %in% c(3, 4, 5) ~ "Professionals / specialists",
      D7 %in% c(7, 8) ~ "Clerical / service employees",
      D7 %in% c(10, 11, 12, 13, 14) ~ "Workers",
      D7 == 15 ~ "Entrepreneurs",
      D7 == 17 ~ "Pensioners",
      D7 == 18 ~ "Students",
      D7 %in% c(16, 19, 20, 21, 22) ~ "Non-working / vulnerable",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    D7_compact = factor(
      D7_compact,
      levels = c(
        "Public-sector / administrative elite",
        "Professionals / specialists",
        "Clerical / service employees",
        "Workers",
        "Entrepreneurs",
        "Pensioners",
        "Students",
        "Non-working / vulnerable"
      )
    )
  )

df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    admin_corr_index = rowMeans(cbind(A2, A3A, A3B, A3C), na.rm = TRUE),
    experienced_corr_index = rowMeans(cbind(A12A, A12B, A13A, A13B, A13C), na.rm = TRUE),
    tolerance_index = rowMeans(cbind(A8, A9A, A9B, A9C, A9D, A10A, A10B, A10C, A10D), na.rm = TRUE),

    admin_corr_z = as.numeric(scale(admin_corr_index)),
    experienced_corr_z = as.numeric(scale(experienced_corr_index)),
    tolerance_z = as.numeric(scale(tolerance_index))
  )
design_w <- svydesign(
  ids = ~1,
  data = df_clean,
  weights = ~weight_final
)
m1c <- svyglm(
  admin_corr_z ~ factor(D7_compact),
  design = design_w
)

m2c <- svyglm(
  experienced_corr_z ~ factor(D7_compact),
  design = design_w
)

m3c <- svyglm(
  tolerance_z ~ factor(D7_compact),
  design = design_w
)

summary(m1c)

library(survey)
library(dplyr)

means_df <- bind_rows(

  svyby(~admin_corr_z, ~D7_compact, design_w, svymean, na.rm = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(model = "Perceived corruption") %>%
    rename(mean = admin_corr_z),

  svyby(~experienced_corr_z, ~D7_compact, design_w, svymean, na.rm = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(model = "Experienced corruption") %>%
    rename(mean = experienced_corr_z),

  svyby(~tolerance_z, ~D7_compact, design_w, svymean, na.rm = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(model = "Tolerance of corruption") %>%
    rename(mean = tolerance_z)

)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)

plot_means <- function(df, title_text) {

  df %>%
    arrange(mean) %>%
    mutate(D7_compact = fct_reorder(D7_compact, mean)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = mean, y = D7_compact)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      x = "Standardized index (z-score)",
      y = NULL,
      caption = "Weighted survey means. Values above zero indicate higher-than-average levels."
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
    )
}
g1 <- plot_means(
  filter(means_df, model == "Perceived corruption"),
  "Perceived administrative corruption by social group"
)

g2 <- plot_means(
  filter(means_df, model == "Experienced corruption"),
  "Experienced corruption by social group"
)

g3 <- plot_means(
  filter(means_df, model == "Tolerance of corruption"),
  "Tolerance of corruption by social group"
)
